app.title: Inside Voice
settings.title: Settings
main.already_running: Inside Voice is already running. Look for its icon (the little ghost) in the system tray, next to the clock.
close.title: Unsaved changes
close.unsaved: You have changes that are not applied yet. Apply them before closing?
status.save_failed: Applied, but the settings file could not be saved.
status.invalid: Some value is not valid. Please check the fields.
mic.meter_help: The bar shows your voice level. The numbered lines are where each alert level starts. A grey bar means the sound is not recognised as voice (keyboard, fan...) and is ignored.
mic.voice_filter: Only react to voice (ignore keyboard, mouse clicks, fans...)
mic.not_calibrated: Not calibrated yet. Press Calibrate so the levels fit your microphone and your voice.
alert.blink_note: Hard on/off blinking is limited to 3 flashes per second. Choose "No blinking" if flashing bothers you.
sound.note: If you use speakers, the sound can be heard in the room. Try it with headphones.
mon.help: Choose the monitors where the alert border appears. The border adapts to each monitor's resolution.
mon.note: If none is ticked, the alert appears on all monitors.
night.help: At night the same voice is heard more by the people around you. Night mode lowers the threshold during the hours you choose so the alert appears earlier.
night.offset_help: A negative value makes the alert more sensitive. -6 dB is a good start.
night.now_on: Night mode is active right now.
night.now_off: Night mode is not active right now.
gen.autostart: Start with Windows (in the tray, without opening this window)
gen.paused: Pause the alerts (the microphone is closed while paused)
diag.help: This is what Inside Voice itself uses right now. Close this window and it drops further.
wiz.title: Calibration
wiz.normal_help: Talk the way you usually do, for example read something aloud or tell what you did today.
wiz.loud_help: Now talk louder, as when you get excited in a game. Don't shout; just a bit more than normal.
wiz.no_voice_title: I could not hear your voice
wiz.no_voice: Not enough voice was detected. Check that the right microphone is selected, that it is not muted, and talk a little closer to it.
wiz.ok_normal: Your normal voice is recorded. Now the louder part.
wiz.result:
The alert will start at {thr} dB, with {step} dB between levels.

Your normal voice peaks around {normal} dB and your loud voice around {loud} dB.

Talk now to try it: the bar shows the new levels.
wiz.too_close: Your normal and loud voice were very similar. You can accept this anyway, or redo it talking noticeably louder in step 2.
